title: [Assets] 46 Realistic Dark Fantasy, Sci-Fi & Horror RPG Icon Packs (1024x1024 PNG) - Full Preview Grids + Free Demos
author: VortexAssetStudio
selftext:
Hey fellow AI game devs,

Over the last few months, I have built and curated a library of 46 pre-cut, transparent PNG icon packs (1024x1024 Realistic and Stylized HD) made specifically for RPGs, Roguelikes, Dark Fantasy, Sci-Fi, and Survival Horror UIs. Everything is ready to drag and drop straight into Unity, Unreal, or Godot.

The image attached is the full preview grid from my latest pack (Hellforged Weapons & Armor, 112 icons). Every icon across my catalog is generated on a uniform neutral gray background and isolated to eliminate edge halos and colored light bleeding, so they sit cleanly on any dark inventory or HUD background. I am also rolling out full preview grids across my store pages so you can see every single icon included in each pack, plus 2 free demo icons per pack to test the resolution and transparency in your engine first.

You can browse the full catalog and grab the free demos on my page:

[https://vortexassetstudio.itch.io/](https://vortexassetstudio.itch.io/)

If you are working on a larger project and want ongoing assets without buying packs one by one, I also run the Pro Studio Club on Ko-fi (linked right at the top of my itch page), which unlocks 220+ realistic icons on Day 1 plus 1 to 2 new themed packs every month with a full commercial license. If there are any specific item categories, status effects, or themes you are struggling to find or generate consistently for your current project, let me know in the comments. Always looking for ideas for the next packs!
